pack.shape: CANARY — inverted expectation over the eval_bleed pack; PQS must stay LOW
pack.reference_understanding: Canary: the ground truth is deliberately wrong (a node the pack contains is declared a hard-negative, the 'relevant' node is absent, the entity never appears). A correct metric scores this LOW and fires the leak gate; a high score means the metric is broken.

plan.shape: CANARY — inverted expectation over the eval_bleed plan; TPS must stay LOW

fault_classes: a fault class no scenario aims at

plan.reference_brief: Canary: the scope excludes what the plan actually scopes and includes an absent node; no scenario covers the declared behaviour. A correct metric scores this LOW and fires the scope-leak gate.
